text:
alex: Morning — quick preflight for today. What I did: scaled up us-west-2 spare pool +12 GPUs (p4d) to cover the morning ramp. Blockers: noticed eu-west-1 quota mismatch (INF-482). Today: validate canary, reconcile quotas, and keep an eye on spot evictions.

maria: saw the mismatch too — quota-sync job returned 403 from cloud API in eu-west-1 around 04:12 UTC. I started a rollback of the last SA change. Investigating logs now.

chris: FYI I paused auto-burst for eu-west-1 to avoid accidental over-provisioning while we debug. Ping me if you need temporary burst. :thumbsup:

jin: Re: prewarm — can we keep 8 warm nodes in ap-northeast-1? We're seeing latency spikes on first-token JIT warmups; last night had a couple spot evictions.

ops-bot: [deploy] quota-sync-job v1.3.7 started at 2026-02-24T04:10:12Z

maria: @jin we can reserve 8, but need approval for the cost bump. Opened INF-487 and added current traffic samples — pls add expected QPS so finance can decide.

alex: For the 403, here's the failing snippet from the sync job logs:
```
Request: GET https://cloudprovider.example.com/quotas?region=eu-west-1
Response: 403 Forbidden {"error":"accessDenied","requestId":"req-09a2f3"}
```
Suspect service account rotation on Monday didn't update the quota-sync SA binding.

chris: I rotated the role yesterday but missed updating the quota-sync SA. Fixing the binding now and will redeploy the job in ~10m.

maria: after redeploy I see the reconcile start — quotas converging, queue depth returning to normal. :relieved:

jin: I'll run a small canary for ap-northeast-1 warm nodes: start at 6 ondemand, then scale to 8 if stable for 15m. Also switching canary to ondemand due to spot noise.

alex: Blocker cleared for me. Can someone follow up with sales about SLA implications for APAC warm nodes? @maria

maria: on it. leaving a code-review ping for chris as well: PR #1024 updates autoscaler thresholds for prewarm pools. Please review when you have a moment.

chris: Reviewing now, running integration job. Will merge if green. :eyes:

alex: Short action checklist for today:
- monitor eu-west-1 quota-sync for 2h
- run ap-northeast-1 warm canary (ondemand)
- finish PR review #1024 and roll autoscaler config
- follow up with finance on INF-487

maria: noted — I'll attach the quota-sync logs to both INF-482 and INF-487.

ops-bot: [alert] spot-eviction-rate ap-northeast-1 = 6% over 1h (threshold 3%). Recommend fallback to ondemand for canary.

jin: switching canary to ondemand and kicking off the run now. Will report results in 30m.

chris: merged #1024, applying rollout to staging then canary.

alex: Thanks all. If anyone needs additional GPUs or a hand with the canary, ping me directly. End of standup.
